securityChecks.name: Rate limiting
securityChecks.description: Verify sensitive endpoints have appropriate rate limits.

securityChecks.name: Input validation
securityChecks.description: Verify request parameters, body, and query values are validated.

securityChecks.name: Document access control
securityChecks.description: Verify uploaded documents cannot be accessed by unauthorized users.

securityChecks.name: Sensitive response filtering
securityChecks.description: Verify passwords, tokens, secrets, and private document data are never exposed.

securityChecks.name: HTTP method restrictions
securityChecks.description: Verify each endpoint permits only intended HTTP methods.

securityChecks.name: Error handling
securityChecks.description: Verify errors do not disclose internal stack traces or infrastructure details.
